text:
nina_k: Heads up 11am PT webinar next Wed. Need X thread (3 posts staggered), LinkedIn carousel, a 25s highlight clip, and a brief PM template for inbound leads. Who owns what? :satellite:

tony_l: I can do the 25s clip + assets. Need final headline + hero by Mon noon. Will export 1200x1200 & 1200x630.

ben_o: I'll write two benchmark lines for A/B and drop UTMs. Routing: registrants -> 4Q qualifier -> score>=7 -> SDR-2 else nurture. Using short.redwood.ai/qualify for CTA.

jess_p: I'll handle LinkedIn copy + comment replies for 48h. Suggest pinning a FAQ reply and batching replies every 45m.

sam-bot: Proposed schedule: "Wed 18:00 UTC: X post 1 (teaser)", "Wed 18:08 UTC: X post 2 (stat + CTA)", "Wed 18:22 UTC: X post 3 (reminder)", "Wed 18:35 UTC: LinkedIn carousel". Confirm or adjust.

nina_k: Times good. Ben, put stat A in post 2 and stat B in carousel. Also add a small $300 boost on post 2; target CPL <$55.

ben_o: Stat A: "p95 latency down 40% on gen flows". Stat B: "unit cost per call down 28%". UTMs: "?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jul2026".

ton y_l: For clip: burn subtitles, 16:9 + vertical 9:16 cut for stories. Need hero safe area note in Figma.

jess_p: PM template: "Thanks for registering! Can you share your primary LLM use case in one line? Reply 'demo' to request a walkthrough." I'll pin that and add 5 canned replies.

sam-bot: Drafts queued. Reminder 30m before first post to verify qualifier form is live.

nina_k: Final checklist: Figma hero + exports (Tony) 7, stats + UTMs + routing (Ben) 7, replies + PM script (Jess) 7. If any blockers, flag here and we'll shift the schedule 24h.

ben_o: One more: asking legal for permission to use a short customer quote on card 2. If denied, we'll use stat B.

nina_k: Thanks team 389. Please drop the approved post 1 one-liner so I can sign off on tone.
